name: WOUNDS_BORNE
canonical: The suffering Servant standing with head bowed, bare torso. Skin mottled with dark purple-brown bruises and many thin reddish stripe-marks across the chest, shoulders and arms. Dull matte skin in heavy shadow. Solemn reverent low light, the weight of substitution carried in silence.
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
